verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a transactional API for one-to-one messages such as receipts and password resets, with per-call data injection. These sends run through the same App API that triggers broadcasts, on a platform that also runs marketing automations. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of transactional sending, explicit mention of magic-link use cases.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send one-to-one transactional email — receipts, magic links, notifications — through the same platform's API alongside marketing sends

citations.quote: When someone does something that requires a transactional message, you’ll call our transactional API to send them a message—like when they request a password reset or need a receipt for a purchase.
To send broadcasts, transactional messages, and fetch data (outside of a _data out_ integration), use the App API.
Transactional messages are ideal for: Purchase receipts, Registration confirmations, Password resets, Event reminders, Shipping updates
When you call the API, you can include data that you want to populate in your message, like a password reset URL or the purchase data.
Broadcasts send a message to a list of recipients.
